messages:
Maya: Quick thread - Sales asked for a stable retention offering for 'translate-fast' variants. They want pinned versions for 60-120d and clear launch gates. Can we agree on options?
Devon: Short answer: three options. 1) Soft-retain (30d free), 2) Hosted-reserved (60-120d paid, pool reservation), 3) Dedicated retention. Hard pins on Hosted without reservation = risky.
Priya: Customers care about latency parity and output fidelity. Proposed bench criteria: p95 <= 350ms @512 tokens, embedding cosine >= 0.95, quality regression <= 1.5% on customer prompts.
Nora: Ops note: reserved pools fragment scheduling. Recommend min-commit and slot limits, plus auto-unpin after term unless renewed. Also suggest a temporary Surge Reserve for contract checkout windows.
ops-bot: Bench scoring suggestion: score = 0.5*latency_norm + 0.35*quality_norm + 0.15*stability_norm. GA gate: score >= 0.8 and no veto >2% on critical prompts.
Maya: Product proposal: ship Hosted-reserved as a billed add-on with a 10 business day migration notice and 3-day rollback window. Soft-retain remains 30d default. Add audit logs for model swaps.
Devon: Launch gates to require: bench suite pass, infra cost delta approved, legal retention addendum, and either 2 customer canaries or 1 customer + 1 internal canary.
Priya: I'll assemble the bench matrix and a 250-prompt veto set and upload to /mnt/onboard/retention-matrix.
Nora: Eng action: provide cost delta and a quick capacity sketch (due 4bd). Product action: draft pricing + renewal workflow (EOW). Legal: retention addendum draft.
Maya: Timeline: sync next Wed after infra posts numbers. No hard pins enabled until telemetry/regression alerts live.
Devon: Ack. If infra flags high fragmentation risk, fallback to Dedicated-only for >90d.
Maya: Thanks 44d. Saving notes and will create roadmap ticket once cost/bench are ready.
